comments.body:
Andrew Woods, Balancing the best location to reject the sparql update that contains the fcr namespace prefix, I have to touch the bottom FedoraResource.java to throw the exception I need. Another possible location is just to throw the exception in ContentExposingResource.java but it need extra overhead to manipulate the String requestBody parameter in method patchResourcewithSparql(...). Please let me know if you like this way better and I'll change it.

See PR https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/673.
Looks good, pending response to code review comment.
See code review comments. The more specific exceptions should be advertised on the interfaces.
See PR https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/673, commit https://github.com/lsitu/fcrepo4/commit/efd3eab5322ebad0670551011be7ecba9ad81aa8.
Andrew Woods, this feature is reimplemented as suggested. See https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/679.

renderedFields.description:
For example, a user should not be able to implicitly create a namespace with prefix: "fcr".
Such as, by updating a resource's property including the statement:
PREFIX fcr: <http://xmlns.com/my-fcr/>

The issue of creating the "fcr" namespace prefix can be seen when calculating the fixity of a versioned resource:
curl localhost:8080/rest/collection/image/fcr:versions/v0/fcr:fixity
